help.name: agent-issues
help.summary: Structured workflow CLI for shared context, initiatives, PRDs, user stories, ADRs, and issues.

globalOptions.name: --db <path>
globalOptions.description: Use a specific SQLite database path.

globalOptions.name: --json
globalOptions.description: Print machine-readable JSON. Entity mutations return acknowledgements; list and relation reads return summaries.

globalOptions.name: --help, -h
globalOptions.description: Show help for the whole CLI or the selected command.

commands.name: instruction
commands.summary: Read and save personal instruction Markdown for the running CLI release.

commands.name: sql
commands.summary: Run a read-only SQL query against the active local SQLite database.

commands.name: context
commands.summary: Read and update shared, project-scoped, and initiative-scoped database-backed context.

commands.name: comment
commands.summary: Add, list, edit, delete, and inspect revision history for issue-owned comment records.

commands.name: issue-breakdown
commands.summary: Create, read, and approve issue-breakdown drafts before issue creation.

commands.name: plan-entry
commands.summary: Add, list, edit, delete, and inspect revision history for Plan entries.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Initialize the local data store.

commands.name: agent init
commands.summary: Install the Agent Issues plugin for Copilot CLI or Claude Code.

commands.name: current-tenant
commands.summary: Show which tenant the CLI would use from the current workspace.

commands.name: project-identity
commands.summary: Show the project identity resolved from the current workspace.

commands.name: list-tenants
commands.summary: List the tenants currently present in the selected database.

commands.name: delete-tenant
commands.summary: Delete one tenant and all of its rows from the selected database.

commands.name: rename-tenant
commands.summary: Rename one tenant namespace across the selected database.

commands.name: auth list
commands.summary: List saved logins in switching order and mark the active saved login.

commands.name: auth login
commands.summary: Discover a remote service's Entra configuration and create or refresh a named saved login.

commands.name: auth logout
commands.summary: Remove a remote saved login.

commands.name: auth status
commands.summary: Show the active saved login and its destination and identity details.

commands.name: auth switch
commands.summary: Activate a named saved login or advance to the next saved login.

commands.name: backfill-bodies
commands.summary: Generate metadata-derived bodies for initiatives, issues, PRDs, user stories, and ADRs when authored bodies are missing.

commands.name: create
commands.summary: Create an entity, optionally under a structural parent.

commands.name: archive
commands.summary: Move one entity to its archive status.

commands.name: history
commands.summary: Read one entity or context revision.

commands.name: restore
commands.summary: Restore one entity or context revision after confirmation.

commands.name: delete
commands.summary: Delete one leaf entity.

commands.name: export
commands.summary: Export a project archive, or an initiative Markdown report.

commands.name: import
commands.summary: Restore a project archive to an empty destination.

commands.name: move
commands.summary: Move one entity under a new structural parent.

commands.name: relations
commands.summary: Show incoming and outgoing relations for one entity.

commands.name: next-work
commands.summary: List ready and blocked unfinished issues for an initiative scope.

commands.name: orphans
commands.summary: List entities not reachable from any initiative.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Update an entity status.

commands.name: edit
commands.summary: Update an entity title and/or authored markdown body.

commands.name: link
commands.summary: Create a relation between entities, or from a Plan entry to an issue.

commands.name: unlink
commands.summary: Remove one relation between entities, or from a Plan entry to an issue.

commands.name: show
commands.summary: Show one complete entity or initiative.

commands.name: list
commands.summary: List entities by kind.

commands.name: site
commands.summary: Start the live site in the background and print its URL.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: Show general or command-specific help.

commands.name: schema
commands.summary: Show machine-discoverable workflow schema and relation rules.

commands.name: capabilities
commands.summary: Show combined help and schema data in one discovery payload.

discovery: Use `agent-issues context --json` to read the current project's shared glossary plus initiative-scoped discovery.
Use `agent-issues current-tenant --json` to see which workspace-derived tenant the CLI will use by default.
Use `agent-issues list-tenants --json` to inspect all tenant namespaces present in the selected database before switching or deleting one.
Use `agent-issues rename-tenant <tenantId> <newTenantId> --force --json` to normalize a tenant namespace without deleting and recreating it.
Use `agent-issues backfill-bodies --json` to fill missing issue, PRD, and user story bodies from existing tracker metadata.
Use `agent-issues context show default --json` to read only the shared glossary.
Use `agent-issues context show <entityOrProjectOrInitiativeId> --json` to read project or initiative context for active work.
Use `agent-issues context search <query> --view initiatives --json` to find initiative-local terminology without reading the full project directory.
Use `agent-issues context conflicts --json` to detect duplicate labels across scopes before you rely on a term.
Use `agent-issues context define <term> --scope <entityOrProjectOrInitiativeId> --body-file <path|-> [--avoid <comma-separated>] --json` to update the scoped glossary when a term is resolved.

Use `agent-issues create plan --parent <initiativeId> --title <title> --body-file <path|-> --json` to create an initiative-owned Plan, then use `agent-issues plan-entry add` to record its planning state and `agent-issues link <planEntryId> informs <issueId>` to connect implementation work.
Use `agent-issues schema --json` for entity kinds, statuses, and relation rules.
Use `agent-issues site --json` to launch a detached local server with snapshot and event endpoints.
Use `agent-issues site --stop --json` to stop the local server on the default or selected port.
Use `agent-issues capabilities --json` to fetch help and schema data in one call.
